subject: Clinix - Sales-to-CS: Implementation ownership & kickoff expectations
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@clinix.health>, Don Meyer <don.meyer@clinix.health>
Date: Mon, 10 Sep 2028 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: Clinix - Implementation summary, key commitments, and handoff

Team — looping you in to transfer ownership for Clinix (CLX-2028-0421). Quick summary and asks below so CS and ops have the right context before we kick off next week.

Deal summary (high level)
- ACV: $480k/year, Dedicated inference cluster (reserved pool) + API access for internal clinical routing.
- Start: target go-live window: Nov 6 - Nov 10 (pilot first, staged ramp).
- Primary external contacts: Samantha Ortiz (Implementation lead), Don Meyer (IT/Procurement).

Commitments that matter to Success/Implementation
1) Dedicated capacity: 2x A100-equivalent reserved nodes for production during business hours; burst to 4 nodes on demand.
2) Data controls: VPC peering + customer-managed KMS. Clinix needs audit logs retained 13 months (ask from security).
3) Integration: two API patterns — synchronous generation for triage (p50 latency target < 250ms) and async batch for nightly embeddings.
4) SSO + SCIM: Clinix requested SSO integration in first sprint (we agreed OIDC + SCIM).

Attachments: Clinix-MAP-v1.3.pdf, Clinix-SOW-draft.docx, Clinix-API-capacity-estimates.xlsx (see Drive link below).

Immediate asks for CS & PMs
- Monica: recommend primary CS owner and lead for kickoff.
- Ben: confirm tech contact for API keys, and whether they want a staging cluster in us-west-2.
- Vivek: advise on rollout cadence (can we do a phased 3-week pilot then scale?).

I'll coordinate a 60-min kickoff with Clinix for next Wed (Sep 13) at 10am PT; please flag conflicts.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0198

---
Marissa Cole
Redwood Inference

Thanks Marissa — I can take primary ownership of the CS relationship and propose Tessa Morgan as the Delivery Lead for the pilot. Tessa will own the runbooks, acceptance criteria, and the initial 3-week pilot cadence.

Tessa — if you accept, first steps from CS side:
- Review the MAP and SOW (I flagged the retention language).
- Draft a 60-min kickoff agenda that covers roles, success criteria, test data expectations, and a cutover plan.
- Identify prerequisites for SSO testing (we'll need a supporting ticket for OIDC metadata and SCIM attributes).

Ben — can you confirm staging cluster availability in us-west-2 and whether the API key flow needs any special scopes for the triage integration? Clinix indicated they may want token-level cost tracking per route.

I'll be available for the Sep 13 kickoff; proposing we hold the meeting as you suggested at 10am PT.

Monica Patel

Quick update: we can provision a staging cluster in us-west-2 by Sep 18 if we have a confirmed onboarding date. Production reserved pool (2 nodes, burst to 4) is available for a Nov 6 pilot; I'll lock capacity once the SOW is signed.

Notes on API & quotas:
- Triaging calls will be routed with a route tag (clinix-triage) so we can provide token-level cost and latency dashboards.
- We'll issue an API key with scopes: generation:triage, data:write (for KV cacheing), embeddings:batch. If Clinix wants route-level billing, that requires a short config step on our side — I can handle this with the infra team.
- Recommend a sandbox key for Clinix to integrate against staging.

Attaching the capacity estimates -- see Clinix-API-capacity-estimates.xlsx for expected token volumes and burst projections.

Thanks everyone — this looks good and timely. A few clarifications from the Clinix side before kickoff: 

1) Data retention & logs: we require 13-month audit log retention and a deliverable that documents log access procedures for our auditors. Is that covered in the SOW?
2) SOC2 evidence: procurement asked for SOC2 report and the most recent penetration test summary — can you send the redacted artifacts or a link to the compliance pack?
3) Pilot scope: for the pilot we will route two internal teams (Triage and Scheduling). Acceptance criteria: (a) triage latency p50 < 250ms, (b) no data leakage in KV cache across tenants, (c) successful SSO login for 3 test users.

We accept the proposed Sep 13 kickoff at 10am PT. Please include a short agenda and a list of pre-kickoff items Clinix needs to complete.

Samantha Ortiz
Implementation Lead | Clinix Health
Samantha.ortiz@clinix.health | +1 206-555-0222

Great thread — consolidating owners and next steps so we have a single checklist heading into kickoff.

Owners
- CS Exec Owner: Monica Patel (customer relationship & success criteria)
- Delivery Lead / Pilot Owner: Tessa Morgan (runbooks, acceptance testing, SSO coordination)
- SE / Technical Lead: Ben Carter (staging/prod clusters, API keys, route billing)
- Ops Escalation: Vivek Kulkarni (capacity/fallback policy & SLA exceptions)

Pre-kickoff checklist (action & owner)
1) SOW: Marissa to circulate final SOW with retention language updated (ACTION: Marissa).
2) Compliance pack: Ben to share SOC2 and penetration test redacted artifacts or link (ACTION: Ben).
3) Staging cluster: Ben to provision sandbox cluster in us-west-2 and provide sandbox API key by Sep 18 (ACTION: Ben).
4) OIDC metadata & SCIM attributes: Clinix to provide IdP metadata + test accounts (ACTION: Clinix / Samantha).
5) Kickoff agenda + runbook: Tessa to publish a 60-min agenda to the Drive folder and add acceptance criteria (ACTION: Tessa).

Risk notes / constraints
- Retention 13 months is non-standard; we need legal to confirm the language in the SOW by EOD Sep 14.
- If dedicated capacity is delayed beyond Nov 6, we will fallback to a shared-prod route with throttles; that will impact latency SLOs.

I'll run the kickoff if Tessa is unavailable; otherwise Tessa please confirm the agenda link by EOD today.

Vivek Kulkarni
Director, Solutions & Reliability | Redwood Inference
vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0177
